# APEX-UI credits

Jarvis UI v3 includes and adapts portions of APEX-UI by Ruben Mouradian / Reznikov Engineering.
Original repository: https://github.com/RubenM1990/APEX-UI
License: MIT. See `LICENSE` in this directory.

APEX-UI itself credits two MIT-licensed community components from 21st.dev:

- Animated shader background (`components/ShaderBackground.jsx`).
- Overview lamp panel (`components/ApexOverviewPanel.tsx`).

The original APEX-UI credits note that exact 21st.dev author/component URLs were not known at publication time. This file intentionally preserves that attribution chain.

The APEX name and Reznikov Engineering branding are not used as Jarvis branding. Derived UI code is renamed and adapted for Jarvis.
